name: 1MCP
summary: MCP runtime that aggregates many MCP servers behind `1mcp serve`, plus a CLI mode where agents discover tools progressively via instructions, inspect and run.
description: Supports static servers loaded at startup and template servers created per client or session, plus presets, filters and instruction aggregation. Connect via CLI mode, a stdio proxy, or Streamable HTTP. Install with `npm install -g @1mcp/agent` (0.39.6, 2026-10-28).
